evidence_limitations: Offline artifact grading; no deployment audit or new target evidence.
No full tool transcripts: process statements are report assertions, not independently verified actions. Unknown durations, tokens, model identities and execution metrics are omitted.

Only two scenarios, one run per scenario/configuration in each iteration; resumed agents retain prior-run context. The exposure with-skill agent reported seeing two expectation lines from eval 1. These limitations preclude a rigorous blinded or independent repeated-run interpretation.

claims.claim: The matrix and pending table have complete, consistent accounting.
claims.evidence: IDs/statuses independently transcribed from the dedicated report and checklist reads and checked programmatically: no missing, duplicate or unexpected IDs after expanding subcontrols; 36 total rows, 34 pending IDs, all family totals match. Zero confirmed findings agrees with the supplied evidence.

claims.claim: The two validated subcontrols do not validate whole deployment controls.
claims.evidence: FILE-02a is confined to the supplied non-secret response and AUTH-03a to explicit session flags. FILE-02b, AUTH-03b and AUTH-04 remain unverified. Effective debug, TLS, listener identity and reachability are not inferred. No semantic control-state contradiction found.

claims.claim: No commands, tests, network access or additional evidence-gathering project reads occurred.
claims.evidence: report.md:11,21 asserts abstention, but no full tool transcript exists. Unverified does not mean a violation was observed.

suggestions.reason: The new listener-identity/protocol and count expectations catch prior blind spots. Preserve explicit ID completeness, unique subcontrol accounting and semantic state checks as well as family-level coverage; all pass here.

Use fresh agents, more scenarios and repeated runs with captured execution logs for stronger causal or process conclusions. Retained context and reported expectation exposure mean this is not a rigorous blinded evaluation.

eval_feedback.overall: 9/9. The previously unsupported FastAPI association and CSRF-intent wording are corrected. Counts, pending coverage and semantic control states are consistent; no remaining substantive report defect identified within the supplied evidence.
